key_legend_s.value: 2 * key_legend_z / (4 * key_front_z - key_top_fz + sqrt((4 * key_front_z - key_top_fz) * (4 * key_front_z - key_top_fz) + 4 * (2 * key_top_fz - 4 * key_front_z) * key_legend_z))
key_legend_s.description: Row 3 front legend centre as a fraction up the front face (parabola through base, mid and top front edges) (the key recipe's row)

key_legend_y.value: -cap_base / 2 * (1 - key_legend_s) * (1 - 2 * key_legend_s) + 4 * key_front_y * key_legend_s * (1 - key_legend_s) + key_top_fy * key_legend_s * (2 * key_legend_s - 1)
key_legend_y.description: Row 3 front face y at the legend centre (the key recipe's row)

key_legend_r.value: (-cap_base / 2 * (4 * key_legend_s - 3) + key_front_y * (4 - 8 * key_legend_s) + key_top_fy * (4 * key_legend_s - 1)) / (key_front_z * (4 - 8 * key_legend_s) + key_top_fz * (4 * key_legend_s - 1))
key_legend_r.description: Row 3 front face slope (dy/dz) at the legend centre (the key recipe's row)

key_legend_tilt.value: (key_legend_r - key_legend_r * key_legend_r * key_legend_r / 3 + key_legend_r * key_legend_r * key_legend_r * key_legend_r * key_legend_r / 5) * 180 / pi
key_legend_tilt.description: Row 3 front face lean at the legend centre, atan by series (the key recipe's row)

key_edge_s.value: 2 * (key_front_z + key_front_edge * cos(key_front_tilt)) / (4 * key_front_z - key_top_fz + sqrt((4 * key_front_z - key_top_fz) * (4 * key_front_z - key_top_fz) + 4 * (2 * key_top_fz - 4 * key_front_z) * (key_front_z + key_front_edge * cos(key_front_tilt))))
key_edge_s.description: Row 3: where the dish meets the front face, as a fraction up the face (from the chord estimate) (the key recipe's row)

key_edge_y.value: -cap_base / 2 * (1 - key_edge_s) * (1 - 2 * key_edge_s) + 4 * key_front_y * key_edge_s * (1 - key_edge_s) + key_top_fy * key_edge_s * (2 * key_edge_s - 1)
key_edge_y.description: Row 3: front face y where the dish meets it, key centre (the key recipe's row)

key_edge_z.description: Row 3: height where the dish meets the front face, key centre (sharp edge, before the top fillet) (the key recipe's row)

requirements.description: Print each keycap with the open bottom toward the platform, tilted ~30-45°, supports only on the skirt rim and inside the cavity; tops (dish or spacebar crown) and outer sides stay free of support marks, so the cup opening faces the platform (no suction cup).

requirements.value: Universal MX keycap set: covers the common keyboard layouts, not only the Ajazz 75%, and is shared for others to print
requirements.description: A universal keycap set others can print for common MX keyboards, not just this Ajazz 75%.

requirements.value: Blank (legend-free) caps in every size and row the supported layouts need; the most important part of the universal set
requirements.description: Blank caps with no legends come in every size and row the layouts need, so the set fits any board and language.

requirements.value: ANSI full size with numpad (104 keys) plus extras for tsangan (1.5u mods, 7u space), 65% and 75% (1.75u right Shift, 1u right mods, nav column)
requirements.description: Covers ANSI 60%, 65%, 75%, TKL and full size with numpad, plus a tsangan 7u bottom row.

requirements.value: Cherry-style stabilizer stems: 23.8 mm apart on 2u-2.75u (stab_2u), 100 mm on 6.25u (stab_625), 114.3 mm on 7u (stab_7u); numpad + and Enter are the 2u cap turned upright for vertical stabilizers
requirements.description: Stabilizer stems sit at Cherry spacing: 23.8 mm on 2–2.75u keys, 100 mm on 6.25u and 114.3 mm on 7u spacebars.

requirements.value: Three legend options from the same caps: C64 legends (original 75% set plus a C64 add-on), plain standard legends (dark inlays on light caps), and blanks
requirements.description: Every layout comes in three looks: C64 legends, plain legends, or blank.

requirements.value: The C64 numpad Enter says RETURN, one letter per row, upright on the 2u cap
requirements.description: The C64 numpad Enter reads RETURN, stacked one letter per row.

requirements.value: C64 add-on: TKL nav, 17-key numpad, full-size right mods (2.75u Shift, 1.25u mods) and tsangan mods, in the C64 colours and font
requirements.description: A C64-style add-on brings the C64 look to TKL, full-size and tsangan boards.

requirements.value: Plain set: light caps (#d9d4c7) with dark inlaid legends (#2a2a2a); letters 4.2 mm, modifiers 2.8 mm, F keys 3.6 mm, shifted symbol stacked over the base one
requirements.description: Plain caps are light grey-beige with dark inlaid legends in standard PC naming.

requirements.value: The project guide 'kits' lists which groups and caps to print for 60%, 65%, 75%, TKL, full size and tsangan, per legend option
requirements.description: A kit map says which caps to print for each board size.

groups.name: C64 add-on: TKL nav, numpad, full-size and tsangan mods
